name: open-ground mage vs weak packs
why: Kill weak melee groups with area spells while they bunch, finish stragglers, and drink potions or escape before hits break casting and health collapses.

hunt.says: Attack the nearest monster from range with strong single-target spells (Energy Bolt or Flamestrike) while they approach; loot when the area is clear.

transitions.when: Three or more monsters are bunched up close around or near the mage.
Health is low, or many monsters are on the mage and hits keep breaking spells.

blast.says: Stand and cast area spells (Explosion or Chain Lightning) at the bunch so each cast hurts them all.

transitions.when: Only one or two monsters are left close, or most are nearly dead.
transitions.unless: Three or more fairly healthy monsters are still bunched up.

transitions.when: Health is below half with several monsters still hitting the mage, or mana is nearly gone with monsters still alive.
Mana is nearly gone and several monsters are still fighting.

escape.says: Run away from the monsters to break contact, drink heal potions when hurt, and recover; do not stand and cast while surrounded.

transitions.when: Nothing is close to the mage any more.

recover.says: Rest to regain health and mana while nothing is near; fight only what reaches the mage.

transitions.when: Health is high and mana is above two thirds.
Several monsters are coming at the mage again and health is not high.
